facts.text: In simulation test engineering, correlation means demonstrated agreement between a simulation and a physical test of the same situation, measured using metrics agreed beforehand.
facts.quote: correlation means the demonstrated agreement between a simulation and a physical test of the same situation, measured with agreed metrics

facts.text: A correlation campaign can physically test a loader approaching a target at 10 km/h on wet gravel, recording brake command time, brake pressure, deceleration and stopping distance, then reproduce the test in simulation with the same machine parameters, speed, surface and target.
facts.quote: a loader approaching a target at 10 km/h on wet gravel, with brake command time, brake pressure, deceleration and stopping distance recorded. Reproduce exactly that test in the simulator with the same machine parameters, speed, surface and target.

facts.text: Simulation–physical-test correlation should compare quantities across relevant conditions using several metrics at once, never one number: scalar outputs such as stopping distance, time histories such as deceleration, distributions over repeated runs, and outcomes such as stopping before the target.
facts.quote: single numbers such as stopping distance, whole time curves such as deceleration against time, distributions over repeated runs, and outcomes such as whether the machine stopped before the target.

facts.text: A 2016 heavy-truck program first conducted physical track tests of a tractor-trailer's automatic braking and then benchmarked hardware-in-the-loop simulations against those tests.
facts.quote: A 2016 heavy-truck program ran physical track tests of a tractor-trailer's automatic braking first, then benchmarked hardware-in-the-loop simulations against them.

facts.text: Euro NCAP's 2026 virtual-testing protocol requires the manufacturer's model to correlate with physical tests using ISO-based scores before virtual results count.
facts.quote: Euro NCAP's 2026 virtual-testing protocol requires the manufacturer's model to correlate with physical tests using ISO-based scores before virtual results count

facts.text: Euro NCAP's 2026 virtual-testing protocol physically spot-checks randomly chosen grid cells after model correlation.
facts.quote: Euro NCAP's 2026 virtual-testing protocol requires the manufacturer's model to correlate with physical tests using ISO-based scores before virtual results count, then physically spot-checks randomly chosen grid cells.

facts.text: A test house and tool vendor demonstrated an automatic-braking controller correlated against proving-ground tests using ISO 18571 metrics.
facts.quote: A test house and tool vendor demonstrated an automatic-braking controller correlated against proving-ground tests using ISO 18571 metrics [Chapters 2, 13].

facts.text: For the heavy off-road collision-mitigation program, correlation tests should occur first when the prototype arrives, before the scenario matrix, measuring end-to-end latency, detection range, brake-command timing, stopping dynamics, repeatability and model error on each representative variant.
facts.quote: correlation tests should come first when the prototype arrives, before the scenario matrix: measured end-to-end latency, detection range, brake-command timing, stopping dynamics, repeatability and model error on each representative variant [Chapter 1].

facts.text: The simulation correlation deliverable should be residual plots and an uncertainty budget, rather than a subjective judgment that results look close.
facts.quote: The deliverable is residual plots and an uncertainty budget, not a "looks close" judgment

facts.text: Simulation correlation should trigger a stop when errors are systematic, sensitive to hidden tuning, or larger than the margin needed for the safety conclusion.
facts.quote: the stop signal is errors that are systematic, sensitive to hidden tuning, or larger than the margin the safety conclusion needs [Chapter 13].

facts.text: The organization undertaking the heavy off-road collision-mitigation program has never correlated a simulator against its own machines.
facts.quote: The organization has never correlated a simulator against its own machines.

facts.text: Having no agreed correlation metrics by the first quarter of 2027 is an early warning sign of failure for the heavy off-road collision-mitigation program.
facts.quote: "No agreed correlation metrics by the first quarter of 2027" is an early warning sign of failure

facts.text: Physical-versus-virtual correlation for one machine and one scenario is among the cheapest experiments to run before building a large simulation platform for the heavy off-road collision-mitigation program.
facts.quote: "one machine, one scenario, physical versus virtual correlation" is among the cheapest experiments to run before building a large platform [Chapter 13].
